subject: Launchroom ops ownership & link kit
body:
From: markus.klein@redwoodinference.com
To: Jill.Tan@acmehealth.com, ops@acmehealth.com
Cc: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com, monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Launchroom ops ownership & link kit

Hi Jill / Acme ops team,

Thanks again for partnering with Redwood — excited to get the kickstart scheduled. Proposed details below:

- Date/Time: Wed, Sep 1, 2026 — 10:00-11:00 PT
- Purpose: Project kickoff — review MVP scope, roles/owners for launchroom (bridges/recording/QA), and run-of-show
- Core agenda (30/20/10):
  1) 10:00 — Introductions & objectives (10 min)
  2) 10:10 — Technical onboarding & integration checklist (30 min)
  3) 10:40 — Ops ownership (who runs the bridge, recording, fallbacks) (15 min)
  4) 10:55 — Next steps & shared action items (5 min)

Attendees from Redwood: Markus Klein (Owner), Jonas Weber (Tech lead), Monica Patel (Onboarding)
Please reply with the final attendee roster from your side and any items you want added to the agenda.

I've attached a brief that outlines the kickoff objectives and a first-pass run-of-show. Also planning to share a Drive folder with links once we lock the slot.

Attachments: kickoff_brief_v1.pdf (pdf)

Quick asks:
- Confirm Sep 1 10:00 PT works for you, or propose 2 alternate 30-min windows.
- Share names + emails for the two operational leads who will own the bridge and the recording.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Product Partnerships | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwoodinference.com

-----Original Message-----
From: Jill.Tan@acmehealth.com
To: markus.klein@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 12:30:18 -0400
Subject: Re: Launchroom ops ownership & link kit

Thanks Markus — Sep 1 at 10:00 PT should work. I'll bring our integration lead and one ops engineer.

Attendees from Acme: Jill Tan (Director, Product) — jill.tan@acmehealth.com; Marcus Lee (Integration Lead) — marcus.lee@acmehealth.com; ops@acmehealth.com (team inbox)

Two quick asks: can you include a Zoom recording permission step in the agenda, and we need a calendar invite that includes the Drive prep doc.

See you then,
Jill

-----Original Message-----
From: markus.klein@redwoodinference.com
To: Jill.Tan@acmehealth.com
Cc: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com, monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 16:45:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Launchroom ops ownership & link kit

Thanks Jill — locking Sep 1, 10:00-11:00 PT. Calendar invite created and shared (see links below). I've also attached an updated run-of-show and added a short checklist for pre-meeting access (service account, test tokens, firewall allowlist).

Links + assets:
- Calendar event: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123def
- Zoom bridge: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=launch (host: markus.klein@redwoodinference.com)
- Drive (pre-read & templates): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cD_launchkit

Updated attendee roster (Redwood): Markus Klein (owner) — host/overview, Jonas Weber — tech walk-through, Monica Patel — onboarding & success plan
Updated attendee roster (Acme): Jill Tan — sponsor, Marcus Lee — integration lead, ops@acmehealth.com — ops contact

Run-of-show highlights (attached):
- Host actions: start recording, admit external participants, enable live captions
- Tech lead actions: share test corpus, confirm token exchange, walk through integration steps
- Ops actions: confirm fallback bridge and contact numbers

Attachments: run_of_show.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Please RSVP on the calendar and let us know if you need the meeting to be recorded to a shared S3 bucket (we can enable auto-archive).

Best,
Markus

Markus / Jill — I can cover the tech walkthrough and will bring the test token set and a small demo payload. Monica will run the onboarding checklist.

Backup contacts:
- If Jonas unavailable: Diego Fernandez (diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com)
- If Monica unavailable: Evelyn Hart (evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com)

I'll also add a 10-min dry-run 30 minutes before the main meeting to verify recording and participant admission settings.

Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
